name: activation-poc
description: POC Activación de Servicios con Kafka - Sistemas Distribuidos 2026

scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:libs: npm run --workspace=libs/contracts build && npm run --workspace=libs/kafka-toolkit build
scripts.build:apps: npm run --workspace=apps/activation-api build && npm run --workspace=apps/billing-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/provisioning-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/notification-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/crm-analytics-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/loyalty-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/demo-ui build
scripts.docker:scenario-3: docker compose stop notification-service && echo 'Crear 3 activaciones ahora' && docker compose start notification-service

author: Sistemas Distribuidos - 2026
